product_one_liner.value: HeartLegacy, now SalesMail, provides personalized video outreach and AI-powered tour intelligence to help senior-living and home-care teams build trust and convert prospects.
product_one_liner.notes: The official rebrand page connects HeartLegacy to SalesMail, describes personalized video and tour intelligence for senior living and home care, and explains the sales purpose. The Sidekick announcement establishes the AI-powered component. Sources: https://www.salesmail.com/heartlegacy, https://heartlegacy.com/ and https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/16/3363345/0/en/salesmail-launches-sidekick-a-new-ai-coaching-and-tour-intelligence-platform-for-senior-living.html.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL resolves to a demo-request form rather than plans or prices, and the reviewed homepage navigation/footer supplies demo calls to action rather than a pricing link. Sources: https://www.salesmail.com/pricing and https://www.salesmail.com/.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Testimonials from named employees at Asbury Communities and Sinceri Senior Living describe their organizations' use of SalesMail, establishing customer relationships rather than mere partnerships. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/testimonials. | named_customers.0: Asbury Communities' Regional Sales Specialist describes using SalesMail to improve sales conversions. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/testimonials. | named_customers.1: Sinceri Senior Living's Regional Director of Sales & Marketing describes using SalesMail and its occupancy benefits. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/testimonials.

employee_band.notes: The HeartLegacy profile reports 16 employees, placing it in 11-20. This is a profile count rather than a confirmed payroll total and may undercount the consolidated SalesMail organization. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists Daphne, Alabama, and the financing profile explicitly identifies Daphne as headquarters. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc and https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56. | hq_country: The HeartLegacy company profile identifies its country as United States. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc.

founded_year.notes: The company profile states 2014, corroborated by the financing profile identifying HeartLegacy II and salesmail.com. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/heartlegacy-llc and https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index shows a marketing article about why SalesMail is a suitable video tool, not two engineer-authored posts explaining product construction. This meets the specified false criterion. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: A public knowledge base contains multiple categories and articles, including Sidekick FAQs, onboarding and getting-started instructions. Sources: https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/heartlegacy and https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/heartlegacy/salesmail-sidekick.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable careers page lists Client Success Specialist, Product Manager and Demand Generation Specialist. None is a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/careers.

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude API; Amazon Web Services Amazon Transcribe
model_provider.notes: The Sidekick privacy policy explicitly names Amazon Transcribe for transcription and speaker separation, and Anthropic's Claude API for summaries, coaching, scoring and follow-up drafts. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/mobile-app-policy.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists SOC 2 only as in progress, and the integrations page confirms certification is still being completed. No completed claim among the five specified standards was found on the reviewed security pages; in-progress certification is excluded. Sources: https://trust.salesmail.com/ and https://www.salesmail.com/integrations.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The financing profile explicitly classifies the last financing as Debt - PPP. This is government-backed debt, not a venture-equity round. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56. | funding_date: The financing profile identifies the last financing date as 2020-05-01, normalized to the requested YYYY-MM format. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56. | funding_amount_usd: The financing profile reports the last financing size as USD 0.208 million, converted to USD 208000. This explicit financing record is preferred over conflicting summaries that describe the company as unfunded or report a different PPP amount. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent financing identified is May 2020, well before the 18-month window. No later funding announcement was found. Source: https://content.pitchbook.com/profiles/company/294623-56.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page's three listed openings do not include an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive. Demand Generation Specialist is not one of the qualifying titles. Source: https://www.salesmail.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail announced the launch of Sidekick, an AI coaching and tour-intelligence platform, on September 16, 2026, within the six-month window. Source: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/16/3363345/0/en/salesmail-launches-sidekick-a-new-ai-coaching-and-tour-intelligence-platform-for-senior-living.html.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete six-person leadership roster and available role histories were checked, with no qualifying company join or departure found in the window. Corey DeGeorge's COO promotion began November 1, 2025, before the cutoff; his overlapping VP end date is an internal role transition, not evidence of leaving the company. Sources: https://www.salesmail.com/leadership, https://linkedin.com/in/coreydegeorge, https://linkedin.com/in/mcgovernbill and https://linkedin.com/in/jaredcollins.
